recorder.title: 📊 Data Recording for Training
recorder.description: Collect labeled samples for each ASL letter.
recorder.left_hand_note: — signs are mirrored from standard ASL diagrams.
recorder.best_practice_desc: Record 10–15 sessions per letter, varying hand position slightly each time. IMU data is captured automatically when the BNO055 is connected.
recorder.tip1: Make the ASL sign and hold it steady for 3 seconds
recorder.tip2: Record each letter 10–15 times with slight position variations
recorder.tip3: Vary: hand angle, finger tightness, wrist rotation
recorder.tip4: For IMU letters: exaggerate the wrist orientation — the model relies on it to separate family members
recorder.tip5: V vs U: V palm faces forward, U palm faces toward you — keep wrist locked while recording U
recorder.tip6: A vs T: same fist shape, thumb position is different — hold very still
recorder.tip7: E vs S: both closed fists, different thumb placement — exaggerate the difference
recorder.tip8: CSV columns: label, ch0–ch4 (normalised), qw, qx, qy, qz
